sections.title: Distress
sections.instruction: Say each word twice: once mild, once urgent. Let the second time sound noticeably more urgent than the first.

items.word: Bachao
Madad karo
Choro mujhe
Help

sections.title: Stern / Aggressive Lines
sections.instruction: Read each line once. Sound firm and cold. Lines marked High should be said louder and faster.

items.word: Chup ho jao, warna theek nahi hoga
items.meaning: Be quiet, or it will not go well

items.word: Tumhe pata nahi main kya kar sakta hoon
items.meaning: You do not know what I can do

items.word: Shor mat karo
Ab bhaagne ki koshish mat karna
items.meaning: Do not try to run now

items.word: Jo kaha hai wohi karo
Yeh aakhri baar keh raha hoon
items.meaning: I am saying this for the last time
